visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand against a plain white wall wearing white pinstriped baseball jerseys with 'Rakuten' branding and short white pleated skirts. The woman on the left has black hair and red lipstick, while the woman on the right has light brownish-pink hair. They look directly at the camera with bright smiles and wave both hands cheerfully in a synchronized greeting. (2) They transition their movements to make small finger heart gestures toward the camera. Suddenly, a blurry figure of another woman in the same uniform dashes across the foreground from right to left, momentarily obscuring the view. The main two women maintain their pose and facial expressions throughout the interruption. (3) The two women continue their performance, shifting from finger hearts to forming full heart shapes with their hands and then their arms above their heads. A second teammate walks past the camera in the foreground. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting their energetic movements and cheerful expressions. (4) A woman with her hair styled in two buns pops into the frame between the original two. Immediately, three more women in matching uniforms rush into the shot from the sides, playfully surrounding and crowding the woman with the double buns. They are all laughing and moving excitedly, filling the frame with a sense of chaotic, joyful camaraderie.

As the visual movement intensifies, faint high-pitched female laughter and short bursts of excited shouting become audible. Multiple female voices can be heard giggling and talking simultaneously, creating a lively acoustic atmosphere that reflects the chaotic group gathering seen on screen. The audio concludes with a final energetic musical chord and overlapping laughter.
